svg.title: GROUP BY throws the rows away. A window keeps them.
svg.desc: Blank version of the sketch “GROUP BY throws the rows away. A window keeps them.” with all labels removed, for drawing from memory. Eight input rows collapsed by GROUP BY into three, beside the same eight rows kept intact with a running-total column added, dashed PARTITION BY dividers between categories and a bracket marking the sliding frame. Below, sum(x) over the tied input 1,1,2,3,3,4 with a 1 PRECEDING frame gives 1,2,3,5,6,7 under ROWS and 2,2,4,8,8,10 under RANGE, with the tied pairs ringed in red.
svg.text: GROUP BY throws the rows away. A window keeps them.
draw it from memory, then compare
